notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29098005/c04dc7d7fd52da52e94dca6175dce28ff241e56a.png

First of all, this update should fix the most anoying bug. The problem with loading next level.

Actual changes to gameplay etc.:
- jumping penalty changed a little bit
- flying controls changed visuals
- UI changed in some places, example: jump stats should be more clear
- small changes to hills appearance

notes.title: Major update is live!
notes.notes:
What has changed:
- minor UI changes
- simple gloves added
- better pointers and reticle (you have to hold down the grip button to activate the pointers)
- turn by 180 degrees option (shift+R only in menu)
- achievements added
- leaderboards added (true values visible only in game)
- major bugs fixed

notes.title: New Update! 5 hills and new night mode!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29098005/968e4854e47d40387f82ca1fcc470ec1737c62f9.jpg

Latest version lets you try 3 new hills (K60, K120 and K130) and a remade night mode (you can toggle between day and night in main menu). There is also a ski shop where you can pick different skis.
